newsitem.title: INDIA: HSBC, MERRILL, SACHS TO MANAGE MTNL GDR-BANKERS.
newsitem.headline: HSBC, MERRILL, SACHS TO MANAGE MTNL GDR-BANKERS.

text.p: HSBC Capital Markets India Pvt Ltd, DSP-Merill Lynch and Goldman Sachs have secured the mandate for the $800 million proposed global depository receipts (GDR) issue by state-owned telecom giant Mahanagar Telecom Nigam Ltd (MTNL), merchant bankers said on Tuesday.
Officials from HSBC, DSP-Merrill Lynch and Goldman Sachs were not immediately available for comment.

The Indian government last month said it planned to sell stakes in four firms - the Gas Authority of India Ltd (GAIL) Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Ltd (MTNL), Indian Oil Corp (IOC) and Container Corp of India .
The privatisation drive is planned partly through an offer of global depository receipts (GDRs) to overseas investors.
The government has set a revenue target of 48 billion rupees from its programme to sell state shareholding in the current 1997/98 (April-March) fiscal year.
MTNL runs telephone services in Bombay and Delhi.
The telecommunications major has already sold off 34.27 percent of its shares to the public.
